quest.title: Justice Is Its Own Reward
quest.description: As per Xingqiu's plan, the Feiyun Commerce Guild bought up all the Cor Lapis in Liyue Harbor. All that remains is to purchase Chang the Ninth's batch and Gentry Maocai will have nowhere left to turn.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x60, Mora x19800, Teachings of Gold x5, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to the Feiyun Commerce Guild warehouse

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Welcome. The final act in this drama would not be complete without you two here as audience.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You'd better believe it! We're the ones who've been doing all the work! What exactly have you been doing all this time?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Ah, well... Naturally, I used the time to immerse myself completely in Legend of the Shattered Halberd. I managed to finish the book off, and I enjoyed every minute of it.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Divine Halberd and Ominous Sword, Mir and Weiyang...

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: The way the story develops across the first five volumes — nothing short of exemplary. But the sixth volume... words fail me.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: How blessed we are to have such an author grace our world with such works.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And this is related to Gentry Maocai... how?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: It's not, but when something surpasses expectations to such a degree, one must show one's appreciation.

choices.text: You saw how everything would play out.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: And it is thanks to your help that everything will play out just as I had foreseen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Why does Paimon have to be the only one who doesn't get what's going on? No fair!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh... So go on then, tell me. What are we doing here? And what's this big dramatic showdown thing that's supposed to happen?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Think about it. Gentry Maocai goes searching for Cor Lapis all over Liyue Harbor, and he doesn't find a single piece.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: He panics — without the goods, he can't fulfill his contract. And if he can't fulfill his contract, he can't stay in good standing with the Fatui.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: He hears a rumor that the Feiyun Commerce Guild is the culprit. Panic turns to disbelief.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Gentry Maocai is a hugely powerful figure in the business world. Never has anyone dared to target him like this.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: So regardless of whether it is revenge or a swift resolution that he seeks, he is certain to—

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: So it was you! You were the ones sticking your necks out for Chang the Ninth!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Speak of the devil.

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: I went everywhere trying to find someone selling Cor Lapis before I realized the Feiyun Commerce Guild had been on an acquisition spree!

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: Cor Lapis is hardly a rare mineral, and yet suddenly the stocks dry up, just like that! Explain yourselves! What is the meaning of this persecution?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: We are not persecuting you, but protecting another, one to whom I am indebted. Upon witnessing an injustice, it is a perfectly normal response to rush to the aid of he who has been wronged.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Was it not one of your own men who said... this isn't over?

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: Hmph. You clearly don't know what's good for you. I won't beat around the bush.

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: Master, if you please. Seize their Cor Lapis!

choices.text: Is the ending of the book good?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: It was rather good, thanks... I only hope that as our plan reaches its denouement, it too will live up to its expectations.

talks.objective: Help Gentry Maocai and defeat the attacking Fatui

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Impressive. You are no commoners... To continue this fight would be to incur greater losses than I can accept.

dialogues.speaker: Gentry Maocai
dialogues.text: Their strength is almost spent! Finish them off! The Cor Lapis is almost within our grasp...

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Might I remind you that the Fatui's relationship with you extends to business matters only! I did not lend you my men to have them stir up trouble at your beck and call!

dialogues.speaker: Gentry Maocai
dialogues.text: Wh—What are you saying? Master, everything I did, I did with only one thing in mind — to complete the order!

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Then figure it out by yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Gentry Maocai
dialogues.text: D—Don't go! Wait! Master! Waaaait...

dialogues.speaker: Xu
dialogues.text: My lord! What are you doing here? Are you hurt?

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: #Thanks to this valiant young {F#woman}{M#man}, I am unscathed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "My lord"!?

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: You... You are the heir of the Feiyun Commerce Guild?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Indeed, my liege. I am Xingqiu, disciple of the Guhua Clan and second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild manager, and I make no secret of it.

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: Drats! I've been played like a fiddle!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Gentry Maocai, coercion and intimidation are hardly the attributes of a respectable businessman. The problems that your business practices have created, I have sought to resolve through mine.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: I shudder to think what the Fatui will do with you if you fail to provide their Cor Lapis.

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: You meddling swine! Well, go on! Tell me, what will you sell it for?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Since you asked Chang the Ninth for a discount of seventy percent, let's fight fire with fire, shall we?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Three times the market rate sounds fair, no?

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: How dare you subject me to such viciousness! This is a malicious and calculated attempt to run me into the ground—

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: ...Deep breaths now. This is a simple decision. Will you buy, or not?

response.speaker: Gentry Maocai
response.text: I... Hmph, fine, have it your way! I'll find the money somehow. Happy now!?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: On behalf of the Feiyun Commerce Guild, I thank you for your business and hope you will continue to do business with us in future.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You? Funny-speaking, book-reading, Guhua-geeking, Xingqiu... Are the heir of the Feiyun Commerce Guild!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that massive stash of Mora you let us burn through in a day — that was from your private vault!?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: 'Twas but a paltry sum. I got to make a very sound investment while putting Gentry Maocai in his place. A classic two birds, one stone situation.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: You're too kind. You have valor in your heart, and that is worthy of admiration.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yikes! Paimon's been calling you Guhua Geek this whole time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon read in one of these martial artist novels that when rich heirs like you get angry at someone, you have their arms and legs chopped off!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Arghhh, Paimon's toast! And sorry! Very sorry! Please don't hurt Paimon~!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Calm down — since you can fly, you hardly need your legs anyway.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #ARGH! Save me {NICKNAME}, save me! This is not a drill. Repeat, this is not a drill!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Jokes aside, I have the two of you to thank for this successful resolution. Really, you were a huge help.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Meanwhile, Legend of the Shattered Halberd was positively riveting. Much obliged if you could return it to Chang the Ninth for me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're making us run yet another errand!?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: I did nothing, and hence deserve none of his gratitude. The two of you, meanwhile, though strangers to the circumstances, stepped in and saved the day.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: To have made such valiant and chivalrous friends is more than enough for me, my liege.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: My lord, forgive the intrusion... It's about your father...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Please inform my father thusly: I have averted a disaster and earned a sizable sum of money in the process.

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Might this meritorious act compensate for my prior transgressions and earn me a few more days of freedom, perchance? Legend of the Shattered Halberd speaks of a domain that I should very much like to investigate...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For all your clever long words, the fact is you're just a lazybones who doesn't wanna work!

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hahaha... What if I told you that a reward awaits you at Chang the Ninth's palace, and not just his gratitude?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A reward! Hmm... Well, that sweetens the deal somewhat.

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: *sigh* It seems whatever I say, there's no persuading you to stay...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why didn't you tell us Xingqiu was the Feiyun heir?

response.speaker: Xu
response.text: Oh, I didn't realize you weren't aware...

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Thank you in advance for returning the book for me. I will take my leave now. May we meet again, fellow merchants!

choices.text: What kind of book did you say you read this in!?
Don't you rich kids take calligraphy classes from a young age?

response.speaker: Xingqiu
response.text: Hahahaha, very droll... My family can always tell me from my handwriting, it's certainly one of my distinguishing features.

talks.objective: Return the Legend of the Shattered Halberd to its rightful owner

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: Finally, you're back! This morning the pawnbroker showed up and gave me back my entire collection!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I'm positive that you must have been behind this once again. Thank you, thank you from the bottom of my heart!

choices.text: No big deal, happy to help.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: Please don't say that. You have no idea how much this means to me!

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: The Chang family was a prestigious household in Liyue back in the day. Unfortunately, after I took over the family's affairs as heir, a series of business setbacks devoured our fortune...

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: Since then, I've saved for years, hoping to restore the house to its former glory... In the end, everything was riding on this Cor Lapis deal.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: Were it not for you, this barren wasteland in the mountains would have become my final resting place.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that's the second heir we've met in this town!

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: I'm sorry, what?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Uh, nothing! Oh — here's your book back.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: Wonderful, Legend of the Shattered Halberd! I was beginning to think that Guhua rascal had swindled me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do people really look down on the Guhua Clan so much?

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: Actually, the art is centuries old, and was once held in high esteem. But now it has faded beyond recognition.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: To instigate a revival, you need to inject some fresh blood, but it's hard to attract budding young talent to a dying art... And so it becomes a vicious cycle.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: In any case, Guhua kids these days... Take that young rascal Xingqiu for instance, for all his talk about repaying kindness with kindness and whatnot, what has he done to show for it? You're the ones who've displayed a genuine sense of responsibility.

choices.text: He's better than you give him credit for.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: Ah, what does it matter? Anyway, you wanted the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide, didn't you? I'll fetch it for you.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: It's yours to keep. In addition, here is but a small token of appreciation for your huge generosity.

choices.text: Finally. Our trip was worth it after all.

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: My ore is sold and my treasured books have returned, I can't believe it...

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: What?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What was that? Paimon saw something fall out...

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: Huh. Nothing, nothing...

response.speaker: Chang the Ninth
response.text: (That little rascal... surely isn't...)

choices.text: Maybe a Guhua renaissance is just around the corner.

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I can't begin to thank you enough, with this there is finally hope for my business again!

dialogues.speaker: Chang the Ninth
dialogues.text: I wasn't exactly my most polite to your earlier — I really am sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Agent
dialogues.text: Don't get too carried away now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes! This guy looks all kinds of dangerous!
